\section{\texttt{POST /ingestion/jobs}}
\label{http:POST--ingestion-jobs}\index{HTTP endpoints!/ingestion/jobs}

Submit an asynchronous ingestion job.
\apifield{Contract}status 202, role admin, request \texttt{JobRequest}, response \texttt{JobSubmitResponse}
\apifield{Details}Creates a \texttt{pending} job, schedules the ingestion pipeline (load + validate CSV, chunk, embed, persist the vector store) via \texttt{BackgroundTasks}, and returns the job id immediately. Poll \texttt{GET /\allowbreak{}ingestion/\allowbreak{}jobs/\allowbreak{}\{job\_\allowbreak{}id\}} for the terminal status.
\apifield{Source}\texttt{submit\_\allowbreak{}ingestion\_\allowbreak{}job}, \texttt{src/\allowbreak{}feedback\_\allowbreak{}intelligence\_\allowbreak{}agent/\allowbreak{}api.\allowbreak{}py:565}~(\href{https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/feedback-intelligence-agent/blob/936886da072fa7025a57c5517b9c90772bedae09/src/feedback_intelligence_agent/api.py#L565}{online})

\apibreak
\section{\texttt{POST /query/stream}}
\label{http:POST--query-stream}\index{HTTP endpoints!/query/stream}

Answer a question as a Server-Sent Events stream.
\apifield{Contract}status 200, role reader, request \texttt{QueryRequest}
\apifield{Details}Emits \texttt{content} events whose JSON \texttt{text} fields concatenate to the same answer `/query` would return, followed by one final \texttt{metadata} event carrying citations, sources, retrieval scores, the provider name, and the answer latency in milliseconds.

Providers without true token streaming (such as the deterministic local provider) are supported by replaying the final answer in small chunks, so the endpoint works without external LLM APIs.
\apifield{Source}\texttt{query\_\allowbreak{}stream}, \texttt{src/\allowbreak{}feedback\_\allowbreak{}intelligence\_\allowbreak{}agent/\allowbreak{}api.\allowbreak{}py:280}~(\href{https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/feedback-intelligence-agent/blob/936886da072fa7025a57c5517b9c90772bedae09/src/feedback_intelligence_agent/api.py#L280}{online})

\apibreak
\section{\texttt{GET /ready}}
\label{http:GET--ready}\index{HTTP endpoints!/ready}

Return service readiness.
\apifield{Contract}status 200, role open
\apifield{Details}Readiness probe: the agent, conversation store, and job store were all constructed during application startup (above). Reaching this handler proves the app object is fully built and able to serve traffic, so it reports \texttt{ready} without faking external dependency checks.
\apifield{Source}\texttt{ready}, \texttt{src/\allowbreak{}feedback\_\allowbreak{}intelligence\_\allowbreak{}agent/\allowbreak{}api.\allowbreak{}py:254}~(\href{https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/feedback-intelligence-agent/blob/936886da072fa7025a57c5517b9c90772bedae09/src/feedback_intelligence_agent/api.py#L254}{online})
